description: GIS-Grid is a dataset listed in opendataportal.at, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by data.bev.gv.at. The GIS-Grid serves the coordinate transformation between the national Austrian system of national surveying MGI (also known as the use system) and the European global reference system ETRS89. Coverage: AT. Its keywords include GIS, NTv2. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.de). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-open-data-portal-austria.
